notes.title: Auto-Save Update
notes.content:
[b]Auto-Save Update[/b]
New Feature - Auto-Save: the game will save whenever the player changes their mood, indicated by a spellbook that appears in the top right corner. A 'Continue' button will appear on the main menu if a save point exists. Continuing players will start immediately after their last mood change.

-Various bug fixes and performance improvements

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
Performance Update
